_comment: AMOS Phase-A triage catalog. Equivalent of ProjeXtPal tests/regression/known_issues.json. Lives in the edge-fn dir because edge functions only deploy their own directory. Edit here + redeploy the function to update the catalog. An open product_issue is auto-RESOLVED when it matches an entry whose status is fixed_verified or fix_pending_deploy (match = endpoint substring in error_trace, OR >=2 previous_error_contains keywords across title+description+actual_behavior+error_trace).
